scope: standalone exact CB Planner V7 policy
transport: Haiku 5.5, medium, Thinking disabled, max_tokens=6000, one call per file

plan.summary: A built-in banquette-style bench with a tall slatted backrest on a drawer base, plus a cantilevered table top on one side.

blocks.name: Bench base carcass with three drawers
blocks.contains: Lower bench carcass from beneath the seat to the plinth, with the three shallow drawer fronts in one horizontal row.
blocks.reason: The three drawer fronts sit side by side in one horizontal row on a single carcass, within the three-position allowance. The base is a continuous low carcass below the seat, so drawers and carcass form one assembly.

blocks.name: Slatted backrest column
blocks.contains: Tall vertical slatted backrest panel rising above the seat, fixed to the rear of the bench base.
blocks.reason: The backrest is a single full-height column one section wide, formed by the slatted panel. It is a fixed surface and carries no operating fronts, so it is kept as its own block rather than merged with the base drawers.

blocks.name: Bench seat top
blocks.contains: Seat-level top surface of the bench base, extending along the bench.
blocks.reason: The seat top is a separate horizontal surface that covers the base carcass. It is listed as its own part so it is not confused with the drawer-base block.

shared_parts.name: Cantilevered table top with two legs

uncertainties: The table top's attachment to the bench structure is assumed from proximity and is not separately detailed in the drawing.
The table leg count is estimated; the leg in view 001 may duplicate one visible in view 003.

observations: B03 creates a separate seat-top block and its locator falls on the backrest.
S01 recognizes the separate worktop with two legs but lists it as shared by just B01.
S01 locator includes a substantial portion of the slatted back and bench base.
The input Front V2 had the three drawers and both supports but failed the Island enum check.

plan.summary: An L-shaped kitchen run with a tall return unit, an upper wall cabinet bank, a second wing, and a worktop over the base carcasses.

blocks.name: Left tall return cabinet
blocks.contains: Tall return unit with one hinged door and fixed side panel at the left end of the main elevation.
blocks.reason: Its single tall front and fixed side form a narrow full-height column, kept together as one section.

blocks.name: Main run upper wall cabinets (left)
blocks.contains: Two wide lift-up fronts in the upper wall unit above the main run.
blocks.reason: Two side-by-side horizontal fronts share one upper carcass; the boundary with the tall column is taken from the front layout.

blocks.name: Main run base doors
blocks.contains: Five hinged base doors closing the main lower run.
blocks.reason: A continuous base carcass with five side-by-side doors; within the three-position allowance as a single horizontal run.

blocks.name: Main run right column and drawers
blocks.contains: Full-height right column of three upper fronts, a lower square front, and a two-drawer stack at the base.
blocks.reason: Tall right column kept as one section, carrying the vertical stack of fronts and drawers; the lower square front is estimated as hinged.

blocks.name: Second wing upper hanging cabinet
blocks.contains: Hanging cabinet with two portrait doors in the second wing.
blocks.reason: Two leaves in one hanging unit form one section; the corner overlap with the main run is unresolved.

blocks.name: Second wing base run
blocks.contains: Four hinged base doors and a three-drawer stack in the second wing base carcass.
blocks.reason: One continuous base run in the second wing; front layout limited to a single horizontal arrangement of doors and drawers.

blocks.name: Second wing tall end panel
blocks.contains: Fixed tall end panel at the right of the second wing; no operable front.
blocks.reason: A fixed panel forming a narrow column, kept separate from the base run.

front_conflicts.reason: Lower square front above the drawers could be an estimated drawer rather than a hinged door.

uncertainties: Corner overlap between the main run and the second wing cannot be fully resolved from the elevations.
Worktop footprint is inferred from the axonometric view and base run layout; underside support is not explicitly shown.

preferred_assemblies: tall unit with drawers/appliance opening/two doors
observations: B03 and B06 are two broad base runs instead of the three preferred base assemblies.
B03 claims five side-by-side doors fit the general three-position allowance.
B06 locator stops at the drawer stack and leaves the C20 cabinet-door zone outside on V04.
B01 describes the upper-left region as a tall return; it does not cover the open-shelf part of the corner assembly.
B04 spans multiple upper positions and the appliance opening and is labeled as a single section.
B07 isolates only the tall end panel.
S01 is on the axonometric image and sits mostly above the physical worktop.
